svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Anatomy of a contour plot
svg.desc: A contour plot of a surface with two peaks. Lines join points of equal value every 10 units and are labelled with their value. Shaded bands between the lines follow a colour scale from low (dark) to high (pale). Numbered markers show a contour line, its label, the highest peak, a lower peak, the saddle between them, lines close together where the value changes quickly, and lines far apart where it changes slowly.
svg.text: A contour plot: lines of equal value, every 10 units
Every point on it has the same value (here, 30).
The line's value. These lines are 10 apart.
Closed rings that rise inwards. The top is above 80.
A second set of rings, topping out above 50.
The low pass between the two peaks: about 39.
The value changes fast over a short distance.
The value changes slowly: a gentle slope.
Colour bands fill the space between lines,
